game.desc: In far away galaxy, rebel Angry Birds battle the Empire's pigs to save the universe! Rebel spies have discovered the secret plans for the Pig Empire's ultimate weapon, the Pig Star, and have devised a plan to eradicate the pig menace. Join the rebellion against the Empire in Angry Birds Star Wars. Discover Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Darth Vader in a brand new adventure! Paying homage to the Star Wars universe, Angry Birds Star Wars reunites you with familiar feathered faces and iconic locations like Tatooine and Hoth. After take-off, each character can deploy their own special technique: Chewbacca can topple enemy strongholds with his great strength, while the Empire loses feathers to the Force as soon as Luke Skywalker raises his lightsaber.
